definition_differences.10fg: GFS GUST is instantaneous (IFS: maximum since the previous post-processing)
definition_differences.d: horizontal divergence of (u, v), centred differences on the sphere
definition_differences.lsm: GFS LAND mask (0/1), not a fraction
definition_differences.mucape: GFS CAPE 255-0 hPa above ground (IFS: most unstable parcel in the lowest 350 hPa)
definition_differences.ptype: from the GFS categorical types CRAIN, CSNOW, CFRZR, CICEP
definition_differences.r: recomputed from q, T, p with the IFS mixed-phase saturation
definition_differences.sf: no GFS counterpart: no snowfall layer
definition_differences.tcw: PWAT + CWAT: cloud water only, rain and snow excluded
definition_differences.ttr: rebuilt from 6-hour bucket averages of top-of-atmosphere upward longwave
